_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: Rule 110 is Turing-complete — universal computation falls out of one local rule on a strip of cells; the actual Turing move, computation from nothing
the edge of chaos (lambda) as the queer between-state — neither frozen order nor dissolved noise; complexity lives only in the narrow band that refuses both poles
Conway's Life as emergence-without-designer — gliders and guns nobody drew; B3/S23 has no author of its forms, order arrives unauthored
the local rule as the political-from-the-small — an SIR contagion shows a global fate written entirely by each cell's nearest neighbors; power is a neighborhood relation
slime-mold computation — cognition without a brain; the substrate itself thinks, decentring the mind as the seat of intelligence
